svg.text: Direct mass-radius acceptance points: RF fields versus free flight
Delta shade: -1 to 0; symbols: circles / squares identify RF model in Delta panel.
Retention panels: circle n=4, square n=24; in Delta panel marks are offset +/-0.07 mm only for display.
Zero-speed RF-off starts are stationary; any RF escape is field-induced loss, not confinement gain.
